email.subject: Problem with VS-200 pump please help
email.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing regarding the VS-200 submersible pump we purchased from your company for our farm borewell (order 50413). For the first year it worked very well and we were very happy. From this monsoon the water flow has reduced a lot, and last week the pump started making a grinding sound. Our local plumber said that there is sand coming with the water. The borewell is 300 feet deep and was drilled in 2019. My husband says the pump is still new and should be covered. We are farmers and the water is very important for our crops right now. Kindly tell us what to do and whether it is covered under warranty. We are in Pune.

Thanking you,
Anita Deshmukh

reference:
Hi Anita,

I'm sorry about the trouble with your VS-200. It was installed on 25 May 2024, so its 18-month warranty ended on 25 November 2025, and sand damage isn't covered in any case. Please stop the pump so the impellers don't wear further. We can book a technician visit: in Pune it's Rs 750 plus parts, waived if the repair costs more than Rs 3,000.

Team Vardhan Pumps
